name: load_plugin_gui
verified_note: Confirmed on FL Studio 2026 (build 5654) on 2026-10-22: opened the Plugin Picker with F8, typed the name, Enter, and the plugin's own window opened (checked by window title and before/after screenshots). Stock plugin only; a name matching several plugins picks the first match.
summary: Open the Plugin Picker and add a plugin by name. Done when the plugin's own window opens.
